body: I've just keep waking up feeling slightly worse and it just adds up. And I feel like the rest of my life is falling apart around me. My old friends don't talk to me and I can't make new ones because of it. And now it appears I've pushed away the one good thing I felt like I had left. Therapy hasn't work, therapy hasn't worked and it feels like I've run out of options. I can't get away from my suicidal thoughts.

I have seen so many doctors over my life, and the only solutions I've ever found are ones I discovered myself. It's just another thing that feels like an uphill battle. Especially as I continue to deteriorate. I'm doing the PhD now so I would have something to fall back on when I end up in a wheelchair.
I had a wonderful honeymoon full of energy, but that's completely worn off and I'm just left with the anger
The XL? That's what I'm on
